（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
C. D.
F. O. REG
No. 36
9th February 1916

Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,
Two high military officers named Zung Tsung 陳正
and Woo Sau Ding 吳少亭 arrived from Peking yesterday
afternoon and are now staying at the Arsenal. These men
are said to have come here on a special secret mission.
General Yang, Military Governor of Shanghai, has
received a code telegram saying that the Military Governor
of Kweichow has absconded. The telegram also gives
instructions to have him arrested should he come to Shanghai.
There are two societies at Pah Da Dou 八棣頭 in Pootung
called Mah Loong Taung 白龍黨 and Loong Sau Taung 龍柏堂 whose
sympathies are with the rebels. The membership of these
societies is increasing every day.
The offices of General Liu, the alleged Chief of the
assassination Corps, have been removed from No.101 Nyung
Kong Li to No.4363 Yu Yuen Li 有餘里 Kyung Woo Road 共和路
in Chapel. Two Chapel detectives named Tsang Ching Hai 張金海
and Tsang Ah Foh 張阿福 are now temporarily attached
to the office.
The foremen at the works in the Arsenal in uniform
since they resumed work after the new year.

Your Obedient Servant,

McCluskey

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
.10
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）
C. D.
F. O. REG
第 36 号
1916 年 2 月 9 日

致上海工部局。

先生：

两名高级军官，名为 Zung Tsung 陳正和 Woo Sau Ding 吳少亭，于昨日下午从北京抵达，现居住在兵工厂。据称，这些人前来是执行一项特殊的秘密任务。

上海镇守使杨将军收到一封密电，称贵州督军已潜逃。电报还指示，若该人来到上海，应将其逮捕。

在浦东八棣頭有两个社团，分别名为 Mah Loong Taung 白龍黨和 Loong Sau Taung 龍柏堂，其成员同情叛乱分子。这些社团的成员人数每天都在增加。

据称暗杀团团长刘将军的办事处已从宁康里 101 号迁至共和路 Chapel 有餘里 4363 号。两名名为 Tsang Ching Hai 張金海和 Tsang Ah Foh 張阿福的 Chapel 侦探目前临时派驻该办事处。

兵工厂工地的工头自新年复工以来一直身着制服。

您顺从的仆人，

McCluskey

总探长。

警务处总监
